caption: Settings of the code host for the main branch

rows.setting: A change reaches the main branch only through a pull request
rows.why: Every change has one place with its reason, its discussion and its approval.
Nobody approves their own change. The record names both people.

rows.setting: The check must pass before a merge
rows.why: The record shows that the rules held at every change.

rows.setting: Nobody can rewrite or delete the history of the main branch
rows.why: A record that can be changed afterwards proves nothing.
The record shows that a commit comes from the account that it names.

rows.setting: The rules also apply to administrators
rows.why: An exception for the owner is the first thing that a review looks for.

rows.setting: The scan for secrets blocks a push
rows.why: A secret is stopped before it enters the history.
